---
title: "Neighbours"
subtitle: "Select a node to see who it's connected to"
---

Click any node on the graph. Its neighbours light up on the canvas and are
listed on the right, alongside a count. Click empty space to clear the
selection.

```{python}
#| echo: false
nb_nodes = [
    {"id": "A", "label": "A"},
    {"id": "B", "label": "B"},
    {"id": "C", "label": "C"},
    {"id": "D", "label": "D"},
    {"id": "E", "label": "E"},
]
nb_edges = [
    {"id": "e0", "source": "A", "target": "B", "label": ""},
    {"id": "e1", "source": "A", "target": "C", "label": ""},
    {"id": "e2", "source": "A", "target": "D", "label": ""},
    {"id": "e3", "source": "B", "target": "C", "label": ""},
    {"id": "e4", "source": "D", "target": "E", "label": ""},
]

ojs_define(nb_nodes = nb_nodes, nb_edges = nb_edges)
```

::: {.panel-grid}
::: {.panel}
<div id="nb-graph"></div>
:::
::: {.panel}
<div id="nb-panel"></div>
:::
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
import { GraphEngine } from "./js/graph-engine.js";
import { mountGraphView } from "./js/graph-view.js";
import { mountNeighboursView } from "./js/neighbours-view.js";

nbEngine = new GraphEngine({ nodes: nb_nodes, edges: nb_edges }, { directed: false });
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
nbView = mountGraphView(nbEngine, document.querySelector("#nb-graph"), {
  width: 560,
  height: 440,
  showToolbar: false,
  highlightNeighbours: true,
  caption: "Click a node to see its neighbours",
});
nbPanel = mountNeighboursView(nbEngine, document.querySelector("#nb-panel"));
```
